name: tailrocks-repository-skills
description: Repository source orchestration with read-only audit, one end-to-end merge workflow, and proof-gated cleanup.

interface.longDescription: repo-merge coordinates selected sources against one exact destination, then invokes read-only audit, existing pull-request review and merge owners, target verification, and proof-gated cleanup.
